description: The file defines a PHP trait 'MessageTrait' that implements methods for handling HTTP message headers, protocol version, and body as specified by the PSR-7 MessageInterface. It provides functionality like getting and setting headers, checking header existence, and handling the message body through a stream.

methods.name: withProtocolVersion
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified HTTP protocol version.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns all message headers as an associative array.

methods.name: hasHeader
methods.description: Checks if a header exists case-insensitively.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Retrieves all values for a given header.

methods.name: getHeaderLine
methods.description: Returns a comma-separated string of header values.

methods.name: withHeader
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified header replaced.

methods.name: withAddedHeader
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified header appended.

methods.name: withoutHeader
methods.description: Returns a new instance without the specified header.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the message body as a StreamInterface.

methods.name: withBody
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified body stream.
